rationale: Single household-survey PDF: strong evidence on cash vs non-cash outlays but a one-off artifact and the URL did not verify — recheck liveness, monitor the ukrstat publication series instead.
Methodology PDF — reference document for interpreting Держстат expenditure series, not a recurring signal producer.
Recurring official ICT/e-commerce dataset page giving the connectivity and online-sales base for digital payments adoption.
National open-data catalogue — durable master index of state payment/banking datasets and the main snowballing hub for this cell.
Registry-of-registries of NBU-held datasets: mine once for payment-card/terminal dataset leads, then archive.
Publisher listing inside data.gov.ua — covered by monitoring the parent catalogue; useful as a lead list only.
DGF official site publishes recurring deposit-market and bank-resolution statistics — a non-NBU read on retail banking and issuer landscape.
Competition authority is the only public source of acquiring/issuing market shares and interchange findings; failed verification is soft and rechecked by the browser pass.
Market-study notice index is a section of amcu.gov.ua already monitored as parent; valuable as an early-warning subfeed.
Mincifra owns the digitalisation agenda, data.gov.ua and Diia; publishes recurring research relevant to cashless adoption drivers.
Single annual index PDF with useful sub-national digital-economy scores; URL unverified — monitor the Mincifra reports page instead.
MoF state-bank reporting section publishes recurring performance/strategy material on the banks that dominate Ukrainian issuing and acquiring.
Transaction-level public spending portal exposes state contracts with banks and POS/ATM suppliers — rare pricing visibility on payment infrastructure.
Tax authority RRO/PRRO statistics are the best independent proxy for POS acceptance points and the cash/cashless split at the till.
Mineconomy publishes National Cashback programme reporting — a state instrument directly driving card usage and cashless retail data.
Diia portal announcements quantify enrolled users, partner banks and disbursements for payment-linked state programmes.
One-off EU news piece profiling data.gov.ua — background on harvestability, not a recurring signal source.
Dedicated Ukrainian payments/fintech trade portal that continuously reinterprets NBU card, POS and ATM statistics.
Fintech trade media with a dense executive-interview stream disclosing volumes and terminal/card counts absent from formal statistics.
High-traffic finance portal with fast NBU payment-release coverage plus a structured bank-indicator statistics section.
Specialist banking news agency — durable source of executive quotes and bank strategy, weaker on payment numbers.
Banking trade outlet with a standing fintech hub aggregating payment-market news and bank commentary.
Consumer-finance portal useful for card/acquiring product-pricing news and corroborating locally circulated figures.
Low-credibility, http-only B2B portal of uncertain cadence and unverified URL; possible dormant archive with only historical value.
Independent analytical portal turning NBU bank data into charts — useful cross-check, but reachability unconfirmed; recheck before approving.
High-volume banking news feed usable as a low-latency tripwire for NBU releases; URL unverified, recheck liveness.
Analytical business outlet publishing original numbers and methodology on acquiring/interchange regulation and the cashless economy.
